hero.desc: I create unique items from natural wood. Each piece combines traditional craftsmanship with modern design.
about.title: About me
about.subtitle: Craft passed down through the years, and a love for nature in every piece.
about.p1: My name is Ilya. I have been carving wood for over 15 years. For me, wood is a living material that guides its own form.
about.p2: Each piece is handmade, from selecting the blank to the final sanding. I use only natural oils and waxes for finishing to preserve the wood's texture and warmth.
about.p3: I work with all types of wood. I am happy to discuss custom orders tailored to your wishes.
products.title: Products
products.subtitle: Each piece is unique. Wood grain and pattern may vary slightly from the photos.
products.item.0.title:
"FIRST TRACE"
 Woodcarving Set
products.item.0.desc:
Everything you need to take your first step into an ancient craft and feel the wood in your hands.
Included: a block of soft linden wood for your first project, a 50mm Bogorodsk knife for precise carving, and a spoon cutter for deep hollowing and neat recesses.
A compact set to start carving, create your first piece, and discover the world of woodcarving.

Everything is packed in a gift box and accompanied by a warm message from Ilua.
Fully sharpened and ready to work.

The first cut. The first project. The first trace you will leave in the wood.
products.item.0.short: Everything you need for your first step into woodcarving: linden block, knife, and spoon cutter.
products.item.1.title: Universal Knife
products.item.1.desc:
A tool of the old craft.
Once, a knife, a piece of wood, and your own imagination were enough to create things that survived generations.
This knife continues that very tradition.
90mm of forged steel hardened to 60 HRC, a wooden handle, and hand sharpening — ready for whittling, carving, and various tasks where a precise and obedient tool is needed.
Includes a genuine leather sheath of your choice.
It doesn't tell you what to carve.
It simply gives you the opportunity to start or continue.
products.item.1.short: Hand-forged knife with a 90mm blade, perfect for whittling and carving.
products.item.2.title: Polishing and Sharpening Set
products.item.2.desc:
This tool is designed for polishing, stropping, and maintaining the sharpness of any knives — from kitchen and hunting knives to woodcarving knives and spoon cutters.
Simply apply a little polishing compound to the leather surface and make a few strokes — the leather will gently hone the cutting edge, remove the finest imperfections, and help restore the tool sharpness.
products.item.2.short: Leather strop for maintaining the sharpness of woodcarving tools.
products.item.3.title: Waves Carving
products.item.3.desc: Waves, hand-carved from solid wood — with soul and love for the sea. They convey its beauty, power, and infinity. After all, in heaven, they only talk about the sea. And whoever hasn't been to the sea is a loser.
products.item.3.short: Carved picture with ocean waves made of wood.
products.item.4.title: Big Kuksa
products.item.4.desc:
A large kuksa, made for slowly savouring your favourite drinks. Hand-carved with soul, preserving the spirit and traditions of ancient craftsmen.

Its shape and very method of making are rooted deep in history — people have been creating and using such wooden vessels for many centuries.

This is not just a mug, but an item with a story, made in a traditional style and fully ready to use. Perfect for water, tea, coffee and other favourite drinks.
products.item.5.title: Owl Pendant
products.item.5.desc:
An elegant owl pendant, hand-carved from a solid piece of oak. It can be worn as a necklace or used as a unique keychain.

The piece can be made to order and slightly modified to suit your preferences, preserving the character and uniqueness of handmade work.
products.item.5.short: Hand-carved oak owl pendant, perfect as a necklace or keychain.
products.item.6.title: Ragnar
products.item.6.desc:
A handmade wooden figure, 30 cm tall including the stand, crafted from several types of natural wood.
The character is inspired by Ragnar Lothbrok and Norse mythology, blending the persona of the legendary Viking with traits of the god Thor.
Every detail is hand-carved, giving each figure its own unique character.
products.item.6.short: Handmade wooden Viking figure, 30 cm tall, crafted from natural wood.
products.item.7.title: Grandpa Mukhtar
products.item.8.title: Gandalf
products.item.8.desc:
A handmade wooden figure of Gandalf from "The Lord of the Rings", 30 cm tall.
Crafted from linden wood, hand-carved and painted with natural wood stains. The hat and stand are removable.
Figures are made to order, but one is already finished and currently in stock.
products.item.8.short: Handmade wooden figure of Gandalf crafted from linden wood, 30 cm tall.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions about ordering and delivery
faq.q0: How do I place an order?
faq.a0: Choose a product, add it to the cart, and fill out the order form. I will contact you shortly to clarify the details.
faq.a1: After placing your order, a manager will contact you and you will agree on a convenient payment method directly. Available options include: card from any bank and country, SBP fast transfer, and cryptocurrency.
faq.a2: I ship orders via Russian Post and CDEK throughout the country. For large items, individual delivery arrangements can be made.
faq.q3: Can I order a custom-designed piece?
faq.a3: Yes, I accept custom orders. Just write to me via the form or messenger — we'll discuss all the details.
faq.a4: Production time depends on the complexity of the item. Usually 3 to 14 days. In special cases — for example, with a complex item or production difficulties — the manager will inform you of the timeline separately.
faq.q5: How do I care for wooden products?
faq.a5: Wooden products should be kept away from direct sunlight and excessive moisture. Wipe with a dry or slightly damp cloth. Renew the finish with natural oil once a year.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.p1: This privacy policy has been compiled in accordance with Federal Law No. 152-FZ of July 27, 2006 "On Personal Data" and defines the procedure for processing personal data and measures to ensure its security.
privacy.p2: When filling out the order form on the website, the following personal data is collected:
privacy.li.2.1: Contact: phone number or social media username
privacy.p3: Personal data is collected for the purpose of contacting you to clarify and process the order. The data is not used for newsletters, advertising, or transfer to third parties.
privacy.p4: Personal data is stored securely and is not transferred to third parties, except as required by Russian Federation law. Data is transmitted via a secure protocol (Formspree).
privacy.p5: You may at any time request the deletion of your personal data by sending a request to the email address listed on the website.
privacy.p6: The website uses cookies to ensure proper operation (cart, data processing consent). You can disable cookies in your browser settings.
privacy.p7: For questions related to the processing of personal data, please contact us via the feedback form on the website or through the contacts listed in the contact section.
